I replied to Kwame in #coastal-team: the official handoff date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics was November 3, 2025.

That comes from Moss's 11/2 digest ("changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03") and Bettina's 12/8 cutover recap. I also told him that, per the recap, Bettina kept running the account day to day through Nov 21 and he took over on Nov 22. I suggested 11/3 for the CRM's official change of ownership. Both notes are public files, and everyone in #coastal-team could already see them.
